isolation: Separate QA app bundle identifier, synthetic accounts, dedicated API port, database and file storage.

earlier_ui_run.failure_stage: Registration success assertion; product scenarios could not proceed.

subsequent_attempts: Allowing the reported Settings switch, reinstalling the QA app, and restarting the device did not establish app connectivity in the following attempts.
The UI test runner had its own local-network prompt. Activating the runner, granting that prompt, and retrying the unauthenticated projects request returned HTTP 401.

Resetting local-network authorization for the isolated QA app through XCTest produced its app-specific prompt. The prompt was allowed. The registration request issued before that permission completed still failed; it was retained as a failed run.
An explicit app permission reset, observed Allow action and a single registration retry still returned -1009 / Local network prohibited. These test-helper changes were not retained as a product fix.
A direct app launch outside UI testing also failed the authenticated profile request with the same network-path reason.
A fresh QA bundle identifier and distinct app name produced the same registration block. The app-specific LAN denial remains unresolved; it is not classified as a proven server failure.
counting: Certificate, install, authentication and network preparation checks are separate from product-flow results. Later pass results do not erase earlier failures.
privacy: Raw device diagnostics and result bundles remain local. Device name, serial number, UDID, personal settings screens and authentication tokens are excluded.
